title: feat: add a websites dashboard to observability
author: ElliotEtag

gist.summary: Added a top-level Websites observability dashboard for pollinations.ai and enter.pollinations.ai. It combines Cloudflare arrivals (sampled browser visits), landing pages and countries; Enter page views; visitor sources and first-touch signups; browser sign-in, CLI sign-in and purchase funnels; and Google Search clicks, queries and landing pages. A Data coverage panel explains what each source measures and marks two attribution-change dates. The dashboard uses the last 30 complete UTC days and refreshes hourly, matching #17001. It runs six queries, reading about 142 MB in under one second by parsing Cloudflare and Search Console data once each, sharing one query across the funnels, and reusing results through the Dashboard datasource. It reads existing cloudflare_traffic_raw, search_console_raw, product_event and stripe_event data with Grafana’s existing token; no Tinybird changes are included.
